systemTitle: ADSE P13 Configuration Truth Capability Register

capabilities.name: Configuration Item Canonical Binding
capabilities.description: Formally binds configurations to canonical elements, preventing shadow model duplicates.

capabilities.name: Revision Authority Mapping
capabilities.description: Binds P13 items to active RevisionEngine structures, maintaining strict subordination to SECP Revision Authority.

capabilities.name: Immutable Configuration Baselining
capabilities.description: Seals baselines with a cryptographic Merkle root hash of all consolidated evidence, blocking silent mutations.

capabilities.name: Formal Change Control Workflows
capabilities.description: Enforces formal change request cycles, blocking direct mutation of baseline items.

capabilities.name: Downstream Multi-Domain Impact Analysis
capabilities.description: Walks the Digital Thread to compute downstream mechanical, system, requirement, interface, simulation, manufacturing, metrology, and safety impacts.

capabilities.name: Applicability & Effectivity Engine
capabilities.description: Validates serial-number ranges and mission profile applicability, preventing overlapping/contradictory ranges.

capabilities.name: Configuration Compatibility Validation
capabilities.description: Detects incompatible revisions, incompatible interfaces, invalid dependencies, invalid variant combinations, and stale evidence.

capabilities.name: AI Governance Boundary Enforcement
capabilities.description: Enforces human-only permissions at the backend boundary for configuration signing, releasing, or bypassing.

capabilities.name: Merkle Snapshot Persistence & Rehydration
capabilities.description: Provides secure, deterministic snapshotting and reconstruction parity via cryptographic Merkle validation checks.

capabilities.name: P12 Safety invalidation Cascade Integration
capabilities.description: Cascades configuration changes downstream to automatically invalidate and reassess matching P12 Safety Claims and Controls.
